company.name: SKOUT
company.shortDescription: SKOUT is a mobile network and community platform for connecting with new people.
company.description:
SKOUT is the leading global app for meeting new people and expanding your social circle. Co-founded by Christian Wiklund and Niklas Lindstrom, the SKOUT community spans more than 180 countries, is available in 16 different languages and can be downloaded on iOS, Android and Windows devices. In 2015, SKOUT facilitated more than 680 million connections, and more than 16 million virtual journeys were taken through its Travel feature. The Andreessen Horowitz-backed company was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in San Francisco.
